svg.title: Cytological deletion intervals
svg.desc: Six deletions I-VI retain the source map's relative positions and lengths. The zeste, zw2 and white bands retain their unequal spacing and original widths. V and VI retain different breakpoint positions and unequal widths. Gray bodies show retained DNA; thin magenta bars mark missing DNA. This aligned evidence map retains source endpoint relations without asserting finer resolution.
svg.text: Gray rods = retained DNA; magenta = deleted interval
